samir: Quick perf run notes from the multivariant pool (canary-3). Continuous batcher fragmentation spikes when routing mixes 3 variants with small compat overlap. p95 went 85ms -> 170ms, throughput -12%, KV miss rate +18%. Kernel churn visible in profiler: repeated select_kernel calls and memcpy spikes.

jaya: Can you drop the profiler lines and queue stats? Which kernels are flipping?

samir: Example lines from the profiler/logs:
```
[select_kernel] model:v2-quant -> kernel:fp16_gemm_opt (t=12.3ms)
[kv_cache] evict: shard-4, miss_rate: 0.18 -> 0.36
[batcher] formed 2 batches from 7 in 50ms (frag=true)
```
Also the pool had token_budget_target=256 set.

nina: Saw similar behavior on pool-qa-prod yesterday after a routing tweak. Quick micro-experiment: lowering token_budget_target -> 128 reduced p95 to ~120ms but throughput dropped ~6%. Short logs:
```
queue_len: 34 -> 12
batch_size_avg: 5.1 -> 3.7
kv_warmups/sec: 0.9 -> 1.8
```

matt: My hypothesis: compat-set churn + fallback routing causes batches to be small and short-lived. Scenario: requests warm KV for variant A, then routing falls back to B -> evictions and extra warmups. Options:
- make variant affinity sticky for a short window (e.g., 30s) to reduce churn
- change queue policy from time-slice to prefer-fill-until so we bias larger batches when compatible
- add a prefilter to prefer compatible variants earlier in routing pipeline

ops-bot: canary-deploy: batcher.policy=prefer_fill applied to pool-canary-3 at 04:12 UTC (deploy-786).

samir: Ran a 10m micro-canary with token_budget_target=128 + prefer_fill: p95 ~110ms, throughput -4% vs baseline. KV miss rate spikes initially then stabilizes lower after ~2m. Still want longer-run numbers.

jaya: Let's also try kernel pinning to reduce kernel-selection churn and copy overhead: `--kernel-lock=fp16_gemm_opt`. And add a tiny KV warmup on fallback path (warmup 8 tokens) to avoid full eviction flip-flop.

nina: I can run a 30m experiment with both changes. When should I schedule?

matt: I'll stage the canary change for 03:00 PST and include the flags:
```
./rctl set pool canary-3 \
  --batcher.policy=prefer_fill \
  --token_budget_target=128 \
  --affinity.sticky_window=30 \
  --kernel.lock=fp16_gemm_opt \
  --kv.fallback_warmup=8
```
Monitoring: infra-perf dashboard + /metrics/batcher/kv_miss_rate + /metrics/kernel/switch_count.

samir: Great. Also watch tokenization distribution — if the tokenizer change causes longer token lengths the smaller token_budget will be counterproductive. If token_len distribution shifts we should enable token_budget_adaptive.

nina: On it. Will post the 30m run summary back here (I'll capture p50/p95/throughput/kv_miss_rate and kernel_switch_count). :thumbsup:
